record.name: systeme.io
record.one_liner: An all-in-one marketing platform and funnel builder for building sales funnels, email campaigns, and online courses.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free plan and generate an API key directly from their account dashboard settings.
record.api_note: The API covers a broad range of features including contacts, tags, newsletters, funnels, courses, automation rules, and webhooks.

evidence.quote: API keys are unique identifiers that authenticate requests to our public API.
Yes, the free plan supports up to 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels, 1 blog, 1 course
Our API exposes a carefully selected set of features, enabling developers to interact with our platform
Our MCP feature currently provides direct access to specific contact-management features
